reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was 'Every batch lab-tested' with a QR on the front, and anyone can print that. No reviews, no NSF or USP mark, and $29.99 for 30 days is more than my usual bottle, so I would scroll past.
objection: Zero reviews and no third-party seal I recognize. A QR to the brand's own lab report is still the brand showing me its own paper. I read the 1-star reviews first, and there is nothing to read here, so I can't check pill size, stomach issues or whether the dose is real.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification mark on the box, plus a few hundred verified reviews with the stomach and pill-size complaints answered. A lower price per serving would help too.
